what_changes: the <|det|>label [x0,y0,x1,y1]<|/det|> region annotation and its four bounding-box coordinate digits are removed
what_does_not_change: the money token and the date immediately following the tag, with no separator, survive byte-for-byte
semantics_note: the digit_run tokens that disappear are the tag's own bounding-box coordinates (geometry, not a financial value); the det-tag grammar (label + four bare integers) cannot hold a money-shaped or date-shaped token, so a financial value can never sit inside the removed span
